title: CaLMQA: Exploring culturally specific long-form question answering across 23 languages
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of religious practices, beliefs, rituals, customs, and traditions as one of several categories within a broader benchmark for culturally specific long-form question answering.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the religion category. However, its general findings apply: LLMs generate worse answers for culturally specific questions (which includes topics on religion, beliefs, and customs) than for culturally agnostic questions. This is evidenced by lower factuality and human ratings for the culturally specific category.
